fields.title: Cast Duration
fields.description: Time in seconds for the entire event sending process

fields.title: Cooldown Time
fields.description: Time in seconds the mob has to wait before using this spell again

fields.title: Do Casting
fields.description: If true, the mob will show a casting animation while sending the event
Conditions that the target must meet to be eligible for receiving the event

fields.title: Domain
fields.description: The domain the test should be performed in.

fields.title: Subject
fields.description: The subject of this filter test.

fields.title: Test
fields.description: The name of the test to apply.

fields.title: Value
fields.description: The value being compared with the test.

fields.title: Look At Target
fields.description: If true, the mob will face the entity it sends an event to

fields.title: Max Activation Range
fields.description: Maximum distance in blocks the target can be for this spell to activate

fields.title: Min Activation Range
fields.description: Minimum distance in blocks the target must be for this spell to activate

fields.title: Particle Color
fields.description: The color of the particles spawned while casting this spell

fields.title: Start Sound Event
fields.description: The sound event to play when this spell starts

fields.title: Weight
fields.description: Relative weight of this spell choice when randomly selected from valid choices
